status: AI-assisted review accepted by the project owner; not independently human-verified or culinarily validated.

schema.topical_grade: 0/1/2 relevance to the dish or query intent, ignoring hard constraints (phase1-rubric-v1 wording applied to meaning, not title tokens)
schema.constraint_checks: per constraint: satisfied_by_reported_value | violated_by_source | unresolved, with source evidence
schema.suitability: not_suitable (any violation) | supported (all request constraints satisfied by reported values; NOT general recipe verification) | unresolved | not_applicable (request has no hard constraints)
schema.pantry_semantics: ingredients in state mean AVAILABLE (not must-use, not only-these); a missing available item never lowers topical_grade
schema.time_derivation: mechanical from reported total_minutes; a reported 0 is unresolved; source-backed overrides listed in time_overrides

metrics_note: Topical Recall@5/MRR and joint suitability over RECORDED labels only; unjudged candidates excluded (never zero-graded); cases without judgments listed in no_relevant_label_cases (never verified no-match); shared intents counted once.
